_note: Static demo data. All prices are rough ESTIMATES in EUR (round trip from Paris, booked a few weeks ahead, hostel dorm / budget stay, 2 nights, food = total for the weekend). Replace with live APIs later.

destinations.tagline: Student capital of the north. Waffles, cheap beers, big Flemish squares.

friday: Train after class, check in near Gare Lille-Flandres.
Fries and a pint on Rue Masséna.
saturday: Wander Vieux-Lille, grab a waffle at Meert.
Palais des Beaux-Arts, one of France's biggest art museums.
Rue Solférino, where every Lille student ends up by midnight.
sunday: Brunch and bargains at the Wazemmes market.
Train home by 6pm, back in Paris for dinner.

destinations.tagline: Chocolate, comics and a Grand-Place that looks like a movie set.

friday: Thalys/Eurostar after class, 1h20 door to door.
Fries at Maison Antoine, beers at Delirium.
saturday: Grand-Place and the Manneken Pis (yes, it's small).
Comic strip murals walk + Magritte Museum.
Saint-Géry bars, packed with Erasmus students.
sunday: Flea market at Place du Jeu de Balle.
Chocolate stop, then train home.

destinations.tagline: Bruges' cooler, cheaper cousin. Medieval canals, student bars.

friday: Train via Brussels, drop bags in the centre.
Dinner at a canal-side student spot.
saturday: Gravensteen castle and the Graslei quay.
Cuberdon candy and a Mokatine coffee break.
Bars around Oudburg, locals and students mixed.
sunday: Slow brunch by the Leie river.
Short walk in Citadelpark, then head home.

destinations.tagline: Fairy-tale canals and zero rush. The ultimate recharge weekend.

friday: Train via Brussels, check in a canal-side hostel.
Quiet dinner and a night walk, the lights are unreal.
saturday: Climb the Belfry for the view.
Canal boat tour or rent a bike to the windmills.
Belgian beer tasting at De Halve Maan.
sunday: Chocolate workshop, then the Begijnhof beguinage.
Train home with a very full tote bag.

destinations.tagline: Half-timbered houses, tarte flambée and a Christmas-market energy all year.

friday: TGV from Gare de l'Est, 1h45 and you're there.
Tarte flambée and a local Alsatian beer.
saturday: Cathedral, then a boat ride around the Grande Île.
Petite France quarter, perfect for photos.
Winstub dinner, then bars in the Krutenau.
sunday: Brunch, a stroll in Parc de l'Orangerie.
Afternoon TGV home.

destinations.tagline: A giant cathedral, tiny glasses of Kölsch, and a very friendly city.

friday: Thalys from Gare du Nord, straight to the Altstadt.
First Kölsch (they keep refilling it, say stop).
saturday: Climb the Cathedral towers.
Chocolate museum or Ludwig Museum.
Belgisches Viertel bars and street food.
sunday: Walk the Rhine promenade.
Hohenzollern bridge love locks, then train home.

destinations.tagline: Canals, bikes, museums and a nightlife that never asks for ID twice.

friday: Thalys to Centraal, tram to your hostel.
Dinner in De Pijp, then a canal-side drink.
saturday: Rijksmuseum or Van Gogh (book the student slot).
Rent a bike, ride through Vondelpark.
Rembrandtplein for the night out.
sunday: Albert Cuyp market and fresh stroopwafels.
Last coffee, then train home.

destinations.tagline: Free museums, endless neighbourhoods, and pints that hurt (a bit).

friday: Eurostar from Gare du Nord, 2h20 and you're at St Pancras.
Street food at Borough Market, pint in a proper pub.
saturday: British Museum and the Tate Modern, both free.
Walk the South Bank to Tower Bridge.
Shoreditch or Camden for the night.
sunday: Portobello or Brick Lane market.
Quick sunset at Primrose Hill, then Eurostar home.

destinations.tagline: Beach by day, tapas by night, Gaudí in between.

friday: Evening flight, metro straight to a hostel in El Born.
Late tapas, because dinner starts at 10pm here.
saturday: Sagrada Família, book a morning slot.
Beach afternoon at Barceloneta.
Sunset at Bunkers del Carmel, then the Gothic Quarter.
sunday: Brunch and Parc Güell, free access in early hours.
Evening flight home.

destinations.tagline: Yellow trams, custard tarts and sunsets worth the flight alone.

friday: Flight after class, metro into Baixa.
Dinner and live fado in Alfama.
saturday: Pastéis de Belém, then Belém Tower.
Tram 28 up to the Miradouros.
Bairro Alto bars, sunset drinks on a rooftop.
sunday: Day trip to Sintra or lazy brunch at LX Factory.
Evening flight home.

destinations.tagline: Tiled facades, river views and port wine tastings on a student budget.

friday: Flight, metro to Ribeira, hostel with a river view.
Francesinha for dinner (you'll nap after).
saturday: Livraria Lello and the São Bento tiles.
Port wine cellar tasting across the bridge in Gaia.
Rua Galeria de Paris, the bar street.
sunday: Brunch, then a stroll along the Douro.
Evening flight home.

destinations.tagline: Two thousand years of history, and a very good carbonara.

friday: Flight, Leonardo Express to Termini.
Cacio e pepe in Trastevere.
saturday: Colosseum and Forum, book the early slot.
Pantheon, Trevi (coin ready), gelato.
Aperitivo then a night walk by the Tiber.
sunday: Vatican Museums (free last Sunday of month) or Villa Borghese.
Evening flight home.

destinations.tagline: Fairy-tale skyline and some of Europe's cheapest beer.

friday: Flight, bus 119 plus metro to the Old Town.
Trdelník, then a pub that's older than your country.
saturday: Charles Bridge at sunrise before the crowds.
Prague Castle and Golden Lane.
Beer garden at Letná, then club night.
sunday: Brunch in Vinohrady.
Evening flight home.

destinations.tagline: History, street art and clubs that open Saturday and close Monday.

friday: Flight, S-Bahn to Kreuzberg.
Döner at Mustafa's (the queue is the experience).
saturday: East Side Gallery and the Brandenburg Gate.
Museum Island or Topography of Terror.
Club night (practise your 'we're just here for the music' face).
sunday: Flea market at Mauerpark.
Last currywurst, then evening flight.
